name: zvid_noise_shutdown_buffers
description: zVid::Noise_ShutdownBuffers frees the noise byte table and FX pass 3 scratch pixels when present, then clears both globals.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this function; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo buffer/FX pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x48d3e0 has no function/address warning tags and validates the cdecl no-argument/no-return contract.
Current BN evidence shows g_zVid_NoiseByteTable is freed when non-null and then cleared, followed by the same conditional free-and-clear behavior for g_zVideo_FxPass3_ScratchPixels16.
The native smoke allocates both buffers with malloc, verifies Noise_ShutdownBuffers clears both globals after freeing, and verifies the null-input path remains harmless on a second call.
